record.scope: Finite exact candidate search, not exhaustive and not a universal membership proof.

count_definitions.attempts: Proposed moves, including rejected or repeated moves.
count_definitions.accepted: Distinct coordinate tuples passing degree/term bounds; tuple strings are deduplicated within this batch.
count_definitions.rankone: Accepted tuples with exactly one s-degree-two coordinate.
count_definitions.nonprincipal: Historical key for candidates surviving the cheap normalized-gcd screen, before exact unit/nonprincipal tests; not a proof of nonprincipality.
count_definitions.membership: Proper speed ideals receiving an exact Groebner remainder test for q.
count_definitions.proper_nonprincipal_membership: Membership checks for which the normalized generators also have proper ideal, proving nonprincipality.
count_definitions.distinct_proper_ideals: Distinct displayed reduced Groebner-basis tuples among proper checked ideals in this batch.
count_definitions.distinct_nonprincipal_ideals: The corresponding distinct nonprincipal ideals in this batch.

duplicate_policy: Coordinate tuples are deduplicated within each batch; distinct frames may repeat an ideal or q check. No global distinct-ideal total across batches is asserted.
time_limit_policy: Wall limit is checked between attempts, not as an interrupt inside one symbolic operation. The final broader attempt completed after the nominal 35-second bound.
